notes: Real clip window 2.5-3.7 s: static-ish low (cam ~0.5 m, pitched ~2 deg up) wide (~24 mm equiv.) view of the white coupe at the rear-left three-quarter (nose pointing left and slightly away, we see its left flank + rear panel with lit round taillights), centred slightly right of frame; wet garage floor, ceiling tube rows receding to the right, a thin pillar far behind-left; the man (small, ~115 px tall at start, ~140 px at end) walks toward the camera from far left, ending left of the car. Camera: very slow dolly-in of ~0.22 m along the optical axis (car grows ~6%, background parallax confirms a dolly and not a zoom), no visible shake. Fit method: pinhole camera solved (LM) on wheel hubs, tyre bottoms and taillight clusters at window start/end (rms 2-3 px at 1280x720) giving lens 24 mm, cam height 0.49 m, car yaw 90 (nose -X), camera heading ~48.7 deg; figure ground path obtained by ray/ground intersection of his feet (head height check 1.6-1.74 m). Whole scene then translated by (-1,+4) m (garage grid period 8 m in Y) so that no builder column sits between camera, figure and car (before the shift a column hid the walker). Matched: car centre/size/orientation, wheel and taillight positions (within ~1-2% of frame), horizon/floor line, figure position/height (+-5%), camera move direction/amount. Remaining mismatches: builder car silhouette (wing/roof shape, boxier), garage structure (beams/columns grid vs the clip's flat ceiling and fog), and two builder-forced behaviours that cannot be overridden from the previs block: taillights start dim and flicker on at +0.3 s (clip has them lit the whole window) and the figure is hidden (scale 0.001) for the first 8 frames (clip shows him from frame 0).
